metadata.description:
This song was inspired by the feeling of wanting to forge my own path in life, especially in regard to my musical creations. Like many artists, I have experienced frustration in the past trying to “make it” in a music industry that encourages toxic behavior. 

I have found inspiration from the blockchain model and the enabling of creators to truly own and monetize their work at a greater level, while connecting with fans in a more genuine way. I am excited to release my first on-chain song and look forward to this new era of being able to do things "My Way".

This song was recorded in Los Angeles, California by Devin Bing and mixed & mastered by Matty Harris. Featuring production by Ryan Todd and Willie B with additional vocal production by Devin Bing. The album artwork was created by Ryan Todd & Son.

metadata.name: The Luminary’s Path: A Journey of AI, Community, and Creativity
metadata.description: In this episode, Sheena shares her inspirations, challenges, and hopes for a more collaborative future in AI-assisted art. She also takes us behind the scenes of The Luminary, a CC0 character whose stories and visuals come to life through community input. Exploring how AI can amplify creativity rather than replace it, Sheena discusses how technology can be used to expand imagination and foster a more open, communal approach to art.

metadata.name: #46 - Kevin Owocki: Gitcoin, Resource Allocation, and Writing
metadata.description:
Kevin is an incredible writer, entrepreneur, and founder.

His contributions to the web3 and tech space has enabled thousands of startups, protocols and engineers to chase their passions. Gitcoin is a resource allocation protocol, to date it's distributed $62 million dollars to date, and revolutionized grant methods.

Kevin's writing is incredibly personal and transparent, setting a standard for personal blogs in this space. I've really enjoyed reading it and highly recommend checking it out.

To support this podcast, check out the links below:

- Gitcoin: https://www.gitcoin.co
- Allo Protocol: https://allo.gitcoin.co/
- Exploring Mycofi (book): https://mycofi.art/
- Kevin's blog: https://owocki.com/

Support the show
